record: JOB 1 — dependence-aware emotion bootstrap with the 2B cells read at L18 (the pre-registered 2B sensitivity layer); 27B at L31. Per dispatch DISPATCH_LEDGER_COMPUTE_L18_AND_PERMUTATION_100T.md.
LABEL: UNREGISTERED sensitivity analysis at a REGISTERED layer (SR.7). The LAYER (L18) is pre-registered (PREREGISTRATION (c), GATE 1); the BOOTSTRAP is unregistered. This product may corroborate or complicate a registered verdict and may NEVER re-grade one. Not a registered sensitivity result.
procedure: gap_boot template from scripts/phase4_c3_grade.py, unchanged except the 2B analysis layer is 18 not 17 (27B stays 31). Both measures from ONE shared resample index per round applied to all four estimators {2B_an, 2B_emb, 27B_an, 27B_emb}. PCA (center, SVD, scores=U*S) fit on all 171, PC2 taken, restricted to the 45 Russell-Mehrabian overlap, held FIXED outside the replicate loop. Per estimator r = abs(Pearson(PC2[sel], arousal[sel])), clamped at 0.999999. Arousal rise delta_z = z(r_an_27B) - z(r_an_2B); depth gap per cell = z(r_an) - z(r_emb), delta = gap_27B - gap_2B; z = arctanh. B = 2000, seed numpy.random.default_rng(0) fresh per chain (matching the L17 call). SE = numpy.std(boots), ddof 0. Two-sided normal p: standardize the delta by the bootstrap SE, then p = erfc(|delta/SE|/sqrt(2)).
reproduction_gate: Deterministic point estimates reproduce the Ledger's independently-computed gate values to <=5e-9 on every quantity (float32-storage read precision, numpy vs torch SVD; eight orders below the bootstrap SE). The L17 reference values also reproduce (base rise delta_r 0.16828961, depth-gap delta 0.20263320). Gate PASSED; bootstrap reported.
flag_base_depth_gap_sign_reversal: At L18 the base-chain arousal depth gap is NEGATIVE (delta -0.0344842), reversed from +0.2026332 at L17. Registered direction is that the gap grows with scale; at the pre-registered sensitivity layer in the base chain it shrinks. Driver: 2b-base arousal_r reads 0.4992351 at L17 and 0.6557977 at L18, so the 2B gap overtakes 27B's. Reported, not interpreted, not accommodated. Already with Adam under the surprise gate.
basis: 100T all the way down. Cleaned analysis-layer and embedding vectors.
return_path: Handback to Coordinator verification done inline (gate PASS); routes to Adam. Not written to the ledger.
